verdict.rationale: The models page documents concrete limits of 250,000 tokens per second and 1,200 requests per minute. It states that exceeding either returns `429 Too Many Requests` with a `retry-after` header, which the SDKs honor through default backoff. The SDK docs add a typed RateLimitError for HTTP 429 and a configurable RetryPolicy that handles retry headers. Missing for 10: any tier-by-tier scaling table (only a mention of higher limits on enterprise plans), the 429 response body/error schema, stable limits (the docs warn they can change without notice), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
